thread:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: P1 - dedicated-pool GPU thermal panic detected \u2014 kestrel-vpc / pool-alpha / node gpu-07. Symptoms: high GPU temp, kernel OOM warnings, live evictions. Runbook: <https://redwood/internal/runbooks/dedpool-gpu-thermal|dedpool-gpu-thermal>. Page oncall.

oncall-alex: acked. Im on it, jumping into metrics and node logs.

oncall-alex: quick look: node gpu-07 temp spiked to 105C, nvml reports ECC errors, host kernel logs show repeated `GPU reset` & `NVME I/O timeouts`.

nancy-eng: @oncall-alex thanks. Is this in a reserved or spot-backed node? If spot, we should assume interruption risk and start tenant isolation.

oncall-alex: checking instance metadata now. `curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-life` -> returns `spot-interruption` flag: false. Looks like on-prem/hardware thermal.

irma-sre: Recommend immediate cordon + graceful draining for non-high-priority tenants, then live migrate high-priority tenants to their reserved capacity. Ill take taint/evict orchestration.

oncall-alex: running cordon/drain. command: ```
# cordon node
kubectl patch node/gpu-07 -p '{"spec": {"unschedulable": true}}'
# drain pods (graceful, respect PDBs)
kubectl drain gpu-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
```

ops-jordan: Started routing change for Kestrel: pushed route rule to divert session creation away from pool-alpha to pool-reserved-2 for tagged Kestrel tenant ids. Propagating now (ETA ~30s).

sam-solutions: Maria (Kestrel) reports intermittent 503s on their webhooks. Maria, can you paste a few example timestamps?

maria-kestrel: we saw spikes at 20:12:05 and 20:12:42 UTC, roughly 2xx -> 503 for a subset of user requests. 3rd-party clients retried a couple times then succeeded.

oncall-alex: customer impact quick metrics: Kestrel production tenant traffic (last 5m): 8k reqs, 12 errors (0.15%), tail latency increased to 1.2s for 95p on generation API. Affected jobs: 2/8 model routes hit transient errors and were routed to fallback. No data loss.

irma-sre: Good to confirm fallback worked. For the drained node I see some stuck KV cache sessions; adding eviction flags so long-lived model sessions are gracefully rehydrated on target nodes. Applying annotation: `redwood.io/force-kv-evict=true`.

oncall-alex: applied annotation + started replacement workflow for node gpu-07 via inventory. Ticket created: INV-89421, hardware vendor notified for PSU replacement.

nancy-eng: We should also add a temporary autoscale bump for Kestrel's dedicated pool to absorb retries while we replace hardware. Jordan, can you keep the routing bump for 10m?

ops-jordan: Affirmative. Routing diversion will persist for 15m and then we'll validate and roll back if stable.

sam-solutions: Notifying Maria with a short summary + ETA. Maria, our mitigation: isolated the problematic node, diverted new session creation away from the pool, migrated high-priority tenants to reserved capacity, and kicked a replacement order. Expect no further 503s for new sessions; existing retry storms may cause short blips for 5-10m.

maria-kestrel: Thanks. Appreciate the rapid handling. Please keep us informed when you have hardware ETA.

oncall-alex: logs snippet from gpu-07 during incident: ```
[20:11:57] nvml: GPU 07 temp=105C ECC=12 reset=3
[20:12:01] kernel: nvidia: GPU reset due to thermal threshold exceeded
[20:12:03] runtime: session eviction due to lost device
```

irma-sre: Action items live: 1) Replace PSU/fan assembly (INV-89421). 2) Add early thermal alarm at 85C for this supplier model. 3) Add runbook step to auto-divert new sessions on thermal spike >90C. 4) Postmortem and customer comms draft.

nancy-eng: Ill open a short postmortem ticket and own the alert tuning. Assigning to @nancy-eng.

oncall-alex: Summary for incident channel: mitigations applied, customer impact limited (12 errors out of 8k reqs), high-priority tenants migrated, node cordoned and drained, hardware replacement ordered. Monitoring closely for 30m, will update when replacement ETA confirmed.

incidents-bot: Created incident INC-2026-328 and added severity P1 -> owners: oncall-alex, nancy-eng, irma-sre. Incident channel will remain open until confirmed stable for 30m. :white_check_mark:
